images.title: Somu beside the building
images.purpose: Show how a 1 metre person and a 4 metre floor build up the 40 metre height of a ten floor building.
images.composition: A tall building of stacked floors on the right, a small Somu figure on the left at the base, with one bracket on each side; white space around.
exact_structure: A building drawn as 10 equal stacked rectangles (floors) in one column, outlined #2B2B2B, alternating teal #0072B2 and amber #E69F00 fills, on a flat grey #6B7280 ground line.
On the left of the building at ground level one simple flat Somu figure (no face), reddish purple #CC79A7, with a small vertical bracket beside him labelled '1 m'.
A grey bracket beside the bottom floor only, labelled '1 floor = 4 m' (equal to 4 Somus).
A grey bracket on the right spanning all 10 floors labelled '10 floors = 40 m'.
Exactly 10 floors, bottom floor the same height as 4 Somu figures stacked.
rejection: bottom floor not four times the height of Somu
any statue, waterfall or other height drawn
images.takeaway: One floor is 4 m, so 10 floors make 40 m.
images.description: A person 1 metre tall beside a building of 10 floors, with brackets showing 4 m for one floor and 40 m for ten.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text and video.
images.teaching_notes: Compare Somu with one floor first, then with the whole building.

image_decisions.why: The concept turns on this picture of Somu and the ten floor building.
